Bhopal launches 10 new electric buses on new route

Ten new electric buses have been launched in Bhopal, India, expanding the city's electric bus fleet to 40. These buses will operate on a new 33.6 km route connecting Bairagarh to Mandideep, also serving Salaiya. This marks the fourth route for electric buses in Bhopal, aiming to make travel easier for commuters.
